title: Feature Activation & State Allocation Architecture
qualification_scope: candidate feature activation, ownership-sensitive allocation, exact 53-family allocation projection, feature interactions and fail-closed layout compatibility; no production allocator or canonical gate admission
architecture_decisions: feature capability, configured activation, scientific admission and state ownership are separate concepts
inactive optional physical state is absent rather than retained as hidden persistent zero state
externally owned hydrology coordinates are part of exchange compatibility but not duplicated in the ANIMO physical checkpoint
crop persistent state exists only in ANIMO-owner mode; external crop mode uses an explicit exchange schema
derived views are recomputed and trial-local scratch is reinitialized rather than checkpointed
diagnostics have a separate observer layout identity and do not alter physical layout identity
fast and slow P site counts are explicit state-shape and checkpoint-compatibility dimensions
GHG and macropore state allocation cannot be enabled by configuration alone while their qualification blockers remain
parser-visible dormant surface stable DOM/DON/DOP remains unsupported and unallocated
physical checkpoint compatibility fails closed on feature, owner, geometry, site-count, exchange-schema or representation mismatch
persistent feature topology is not dynamically mutated during a normal timestep commit without a separately qualified topology-transition contract
ARCH04 defines logical allocation semantics, not concrete memory packing, precision, language types or production allocator strategy
remaining_blockers: MIGRATION_DAG still requires qualified migration baseline QM before canonical STATE admission
PREP02 historical or independently trusted reference environment remains unresolved
controlled immutable B0 retention remains a separate governance gate
generic TIME and acceptance/retry semantics remain unqualified
precision/numerical policy is intentionally only referenced, not defined by ARCH04
supplied testbank has no active macropore case
TCD-029 multi-site fast-sorption behaviour requires explicit corrected scientific contract before production admission
TCD-024 slow-site parameter indexing remains scientifically unqualified for correction
no production memory layout, allocator, checkpoint serializer or feature-topology runtime exists

parallel_now: define a candidate exchange-schema architecture for external hydrology and crop owners using ARCH01/ARCH04 ownership boundaries
define a candidate normalized model-configuration manifest that produces feature_set_id and physical_layout_id without implementing production state
prepare performance-oriented execution-class grouping rules from physical_layout_id while keeping physics/configuration semantics unchanged
continue PREP02 reference recovery and controlled B0 retention independently
serial_after_qm: qualify or revise ARCH01 as canonical STATE
then implement and benchmark concrete feature-aware memory allocation
